meta.source: Component hours hand-copied from Install_Labor_HackOHIO.xlsx in hackohio/aep_challenge_hack26 (sheets: Labor time material related, Labor only work, Indirect Labor Multiplier). Values rounded to 3 decimals.
meta.units: Hours of direct labor (wrench time). Multiply direct hours by indirectLaborMultiplier to get person-hours including staging, safety, traffic control, material handling, switching, travel, and environmental delay.
meta.jobs: Repair jobs from the team's time sheet (Chat AEP Time Calculations.csv). Each job's install and remove hours are the sum of the workbook component times listed in 'components'; 'job' is the sheet's job number. restorationModel.js picks the job for each damaged asset; for a pole, the job depends on what's mounted on it.
meta.recipes: Fallback for the two asset types the time sheet doesn't cover (Step Transformer, Light): [component, quantity, "install" | "remove" | "both"] from 'cu'.

secondaryPole.components: Base Pole + Grounding + Secondary Conductor Attachment

excavation.label: Manual Excavation (Hand Dig), 1 cubic foot
excavation.appliesWhen: A job sets a new pole and the site needs hand digging. Each pole site has a fixed 50% chance (hashed from the pole ID), so a site either needs it or doesn't, in every storm. The workbook prices hand digging per cubic foot; 1 cubic foot is the team's assumption.

confinedProperty.label: Confined Property Access (backyard)
confinedProperty.appliesWhen: Special_Eq = Backyard Bucket or Yard Dog

specializedHandling.label: Specialized Handling Adder
specializedHandling.appliesWhen: Special_Eq = Big Bucket, Material Handler, Tandem Bucket, Tandem Line, or Other
